title: Lightning Core
body:
"a core harnessed be the power of electricity... how sparking..."

It spawns in the center of an Electrified Meteorite's crash site, much like its normal counterpart.

Used to create a Lightningbane

can be sold for the same price as the normal meteor core ($6,799)

Trivia

  • This core cannot be used to make an Infused Core.
